meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Microsoft Graph 为 AI 代理创建和管理身份:先建 Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal,再逐个建 Agent Identity,并配置授权与令牌交换(OBO、跨租户)。
howto.when: 当要求创建 Agent Identity Blueprint、配置 fmi_path/OBO 令牌交换、部署 AgentID 侧车时触发;标准 Entra 应用注册、Foundry 代理创作不适用。

say.note: Claude 会通过 Graph 创建这两个对象。

say.text: 为代理实例建 Agent Identity,并授予 Graph 权限。
say.note: 权限只对该代理身份生效。

say.text: 配置 fmi_path 令牌交换。

howto.what_en: Claude uses Microsoft Graph to create and manage identities for AI agents: first a Blueprint and BlueprintPrincipal, then per-instance Agent Identities, and configures permissions and token exchange (OBO, cross-tenant).
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to create Agent Identity Blueprints, configure fmi_path/OBO token exchange, or deploy the AgentID sidecar; not for standard Entra app registration or Foundry agent authoring.

say_en.text: Create a Blueprint and a BlueprintPrincipal.
say_en.note: Claude will create both objects via Microsoft Graph.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity for my agent instance and grant it Graph permissions.
say_en.note: Permissions apply only to that Agent Identity.
